feeds.title: Positive Psychology Blog
feeds.description: PositivePsychology.com is an online resource for practitioners who want to put positive psychology into practice. Covers articles on Positive Psychology, Mindfulness, Body & Brain, Strengths & Virtues, Optimism & Mindset, Coaching & Application, Therapies, and more.

feeds.title: Greater Good
feeds.description: The Greater Good Science Center studies the psychology, sociology, and neuroscience of well-being, and teaches skills that foster a thriving, resilient, and compassionate society.

feeds.title: The Happiness Institute
feeds.description: Dr. Tim Sharp's mission is to help people enhance happiness in their lives. He covers articles on Happy Tips and Positive Psychology. Dr. Timothy Sharp is an internationally renowned leader in the field of Positive Psychology.

feeds.title: The Positive Psychology People
feeds.description: Covers articles on Mental Health, Mindfulness, Spirituality, Gratitude, Compassion, Communication, Confidence, Faith, and more. Author Lesley Lyle wants to make a positive difference in the world through the application of positive psychology.

feeds.title: Positive Prescription
feeds.description: Get Inspired, Maximize Mood, Optimize every day, Navigate Anxiety, and Cultivate Connections with the help of this blog. Positive Prescription SM is about making life just a little bit better: the tweaks and changes that are life-enhancing and resilience-building.

feeds.title: Positive Psychology India
feeds.description: Covers articles on Coaching, Gratitude, Happiness, Mindfulness, Positive Health, Positive Psychology, Well-being and Forgiveness. Positive Psychology India is a collective of people who are passionate about Positive Psychology and through our network of Positive Psychologists, Trainers, Educators and Coaches.

feeds.title: Positive Wellbeing Psychology Blog
feeds.description: This psychology blog provides evidence-based findings, practical tips on maintaining positive mental health and wellbeing, book recommendations, interesting articles, and more. Author Emily Burton offerss in-person and online psychological support for adults, children, adolescents & their families.

feeds.title: Positive Psychology News
feeds.description: A daily boost of Global news on positive psychology and research-based happiness. Authored by graduates of MAPP programs around the world.

feeds.title: Wholebeing Institute Blog
feeds.description: Faculty and practitioners share wisdom on positive psychology, health and wellness, mindfulness, and living the good life. Wholebeing Institute is an educational organization focusing on research-based courses that help people live life to its fullest spiritually, physically, intellectually, relationally, and emotionally.

feeds.title: The Positivity Company Blog
feeds.description: Helping you to apply the science of well-being in schools, organizations & everyday life. These blogs are true stories integrated with peer-reviewed research. The author's hope is that they are captivating and through example help you to improve your life and the lives of others.

feeds.title: Jodie Cooper Blog
feeds.description: An intrepid Aussie family putting positive psychology to practice on their travels. Author Jodie Cooper is a Positive Psychology Coach, Author & Motivational Speaker who helps business people use positivity every day.

feeds.title: Eva Centeno Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on Gratitude, Kindness, Positive Psychology Coaching, Mindfulness, Self-compassion, Friendship, Goal setting, Retirement, Wisdom, and Self-love. Author Eva Centeno is a certified positive psychology practitioner and life coach.

feeds.title: Positive Psychology in Action Blog
feeds.description: PPIA is a blog about the science of happiness that offers free, practical, and evidence-based tips from positive psychology research. PPIA aims to spread flourishing and help people live happier and more fulfilling lives.

feeds.title: Kelly Campino
feeds.description: Certified Leadership Coach, Kelly Campino, writes on Positive Psychology, Leadership, Mindset Blog for Leaders & Executives.

feeds.title: What Matters Most?
feeds.description: This blog focuses on what is best in human beings. It trends toward experiences and expressions that are universal, namely the experience of mindfulness and the use of character strengths. Author Ryan M. Niemiec is a leading figure in the education, research, and practice of character strengths and in positive psychology/well-being.
